title: The internet is single-player
vo: The internet is single-player. We share a link, everyone reads it alone, and the conversation happens somewhere else. LinkRoom puts the people back on the page.

title: Your reading HQ
vo: Every link and every PDF becomes a live room. Your dashboard shows which rooms are running, who is reading right now, your study groups, and a shared calendar, all in one place.

title: Multiple documents, one room
vo: Add as many sources as you need. Drop in PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and Markdown files, paste a web link, or pull straight from Google Drive. Every source sits side by side, and you choose which ones the AI should use.

title: YouTube to document
vo: Got a lecture on YouTube? Paste the link, and LinkRoom reads the captions, turning the video into a timestamped document your group can highlight and question, just like text.

title: Annotations and text boxes
vo: Reading together means marking things up. Highlight, underline, draw, or drop a text box anywhere on the page. Every mark shows up in your own colour, live, for everyone in the room.

title: Live cursors and follow mode
vo: You can always see where everyone is. Live cursors show each reader's position, the activity feed tracks every highlight and question, and follow mode lets you ride along with a friend's scroll.

title: Laser Focus
vo: Need everyone on the same line? Laser Focus pulls the whole room to your paragraph in one click. Everyone, look here.

title: Huddle voice chat
vo: When typing is too slow, start a huddle. Talk it through by voice with live captions, and when you hang up, the AI writes the notes: questions, action items and key points, anchored to the passages you were reading.

title: AI Lens
vo: AI Lens lets you drag over any part of a page, a diagram, a table, a scanned equation, and ask about exactly that.

title: AI chat with citations
vo: AI chat answers across all of your sources, with citations that jump straight to the passage.

title: Studio
vo: And Studio turns your sources into study material in one click. A summary. A quiz to check what stuck. Flashcards to remember key terms. A mind map of how ideas connect. And a one-page infographic.

title: Dynamic study rooms
vo: Rooms are dynamic. Organise them into groups, decide who can view or edit, chat in the discussion tab, keep a shared notebook, and catch up instantly with While you were away.

title: Make your next read multiplayer
vo: Reading was never meant to be a solitary act. LinkRoom. Make your next read multiplayer.
